description: This file defines the 'Information' model class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles CRUD operations, descriptions, store associations, layouts, and SEO URLs for information records in the admin catalog module.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Model class encapsulating database operations related to informational pages in the Opencart catalog module.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Creates a new information record in the database, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts, then returns its ID.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Updates an existing information record and its related descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific information record.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Removes an information record and all its related descriptions, store associations, layouts, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific information record with its description in the current language.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Fetches a list of information records based on optional filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalInformations
methods.description: Returns the total count of information records matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds description entries for an information record across different languages.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific information record.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions in a specific language across all information records.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific information record.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an information record with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Deletes all store associations for an information record.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all information associations with a specific store.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs linked to an information record.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates an information record with a specific layout for a store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for an information record.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Removes all information-layout associations with a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all layout associations linked to a specific store.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Fetches all layout IDs associated with an information record.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many information records are associated with a particular layout.
